advice.title: Dry calibration looks like it was taken in air
advice.detail: The dry point is stored at 2888 mV, which is what this board reads with nothing across the electrodes. Air is an open circuit; dry soil is a resistor and reads well below it. So 0% sits where the soil can never reach, the watering thresholds may never fire, and a probe that falls out looks like a thirsty pot. Recalibrate in soil that is genuinely dry.

advice.title: Feed it
advice.detail: Growing season, and the last feed was logged never. A balanced or slightly nitrogen-heavy liquid feed once a month from March to September is plenty - olives overfed on nitrogen put on soft growth and fruit badly. Mark it done with /api/ack?task=feed.

advice.title: Current state
advice.detail: Soil 60% (1989 mV), watered 2 days ago. 0.1 h of history retained. Watering is detected automatically from the step in the reading; log one by hand with /api/ack?task=water if you water with the probe out.
